answer: Offer a refundable subsidy to any identity whose work passes review, but require the applicant to front the full cost of its own operations before any payout. An operator funding a thousand puppets must carry a thousand payrolls through the entire horizon of each paid job, every funding thread traced in the ledger, every withdrawal signed like a plume. When a puppet is exposed its subsidy stalls and the operator swallows the sunk cost, so cloning only multiplies money at risk instead of reward. Honest agents front their own cost and keep the refund.
